[b]2025: The World, The Kingdom[/b]

The sun shone bright over the towers of Tharkønn, the capital of the kingdom of Thýren. The economy had recovered quickly over the past decade since the 2015 stock market slump, which saw millions of Lyr lost due to overspeculation in the markets. As a result the government had doled out millions in aide and aide programmes which had helped the nation gradually rebuild its economy. While not fully recovered, inflation had taken a major plunge, unemployment had finally leveled out to 12% from 23% and industry had once again begun to stabilize. 

It was to this state of affairs that the 81-year old Dúrkan (Monarch), Mij Drs oversaw, she had reigned for the past 43 years, proving to be a popular monarch thanks to her reversing of her fathers dangerous anti-democratic policies which saw the state thrown into a near junta in the mid-60s. This had heavily caused a loss of trust in the institution of the Dúrkan, however, thanks to Mij, trust had been gradually restored. 

Today was to be a busy day, the highly isolated nation, which remained quiet on the world stage, taking up land on the south of Elesyr but not fully interacting with their fellow nations or neighbors. However, intelligence from beyond the country's shores showed a rapidly changing world of which questions arose as to where Thýven stood on the world stage. It was evident that Thýven would have to step out of its comfort zone and move towards international recognition.

Mij walked down the carpeted hallway of the Tharkønn Palace, the seat of the monarchy for almost 500 years, having grown from a small hunting lodge into a sprawling palace that covered an area almost twice the size of Versailles. Her House Steward walked briskly aside her holding several pieces of legislation which had been submitted to her by the Gøsfodde. 

The National Intelligence Directorate has suggested we approach the United Republics of Elesyr and Vesperia, due to their position along the Thørnn strait, stated the House Steward, a shorter than usual male Thrømm with an almost effeminate appearance and small antlers. 

Intriguing, I assume the NID has also provided details as to the position of the United Republics, politically and whatnot? enquired Mij.

Unfortunately we have been unable to parse too much information, as we cannot enter by our own law, into their country, replied the House Steward.

Mij sighed as they approached the doors of her office, before replying, Tell the NID to continue probing around, in the meantime, there are more pertinent matters to look into, come now,

With that she opened the door to her office, a grand and long space with a mahogany ceiling, grand marble and wainscotting walls, a large fireplace stood to the left of the room opposite four massive floor to ceiling windows, her desk sat at the opposite of the door which was at one end of the room. A dim light filtered through the windows as it had been raining and the clouds had yet to become sunny once more. Moving to her desk, her steward sitting himself on one of the couches near the fire, the two began that day's business.
